frozenPolicy: B01 approves a reviewed revision, not an immutable case count. Preserve existing required problems and valid semantics; revise faulty recipes/oracles with independent evidence and review, append new counterexamples, never refresh from engine output or change required Java to Smali to obtain a pass.
designNotice: Specifications, not runnable assets. Schema 2 binds each invocation id/input/expected together. B01 review, B02 executable assets/tool locks, B03 independent certification and B04 authorized harness falsification are all still required; draft-5 is not approval or execution evidence. Resource quotas are opt-in; no speculative JVM-size admission.

invocationPolicy.required: Every invocation is required. Match by case id + invocation id; no index-zipped expected arrays, optional branches, any-error substitution or partial case pass.
invocationPolicy.selectors: targetRole(s) and full name+proto are resolved by the independent manifest to original physical/logical ClassKey/MethodKey, never display-name first match. The default role case must also be bound explicitly in that manifest. When method is omitted at a method/raw seam, the role itself must bind exactly one original MethodKey; a class role alone is insufficient. args=[] is implicit only for a zero-parameter call.
invocationPolicy.inputs: method is name+full binary proto; args are formal-type-directed. {new,identity,fields}, {arrayType,values,identity}, {stringUnits}, {floatBits} describe Driver-owned setup, not production object factories. calls/repeat run in one isolated Driver instance unless isolation says fresh-jvm.
invocationPolicy.limits: All resource quota fields default to None: an omitted field or null means no quota, while integer 0 is an explicit zero limit. Test inputs name only caller-selected limits; adapters must not restore numeric defaults. Real format ranges, checked arithmetic, allocation failure, cancellation and backpressure remain mandatory.
invocationPolicy.outputs: expected fields are mandatory semantic assertions, not literal public report field spellings. Adapter projects actual public results/independent artifacts without inferring success from input/expected. java means every requested method is Java, or every requested class is JavaUnit for full-unit/full-unit-set. Raw checks use an independent decoder.
invocationPolicy.ordering: Program event/call/array/handler order is exact; independent symbol/report results match original-key multisets without requiring publication order. No private Phi/AST/local-name/phase-count goldens.
invocationPolicy.compactValues: stringPattern fully expands zeroPrefixUnits copies of U+0000 plus optional lastUnit; file pattern byte i=(i*multiplier+add)%256 for exactly length bytes. Length/hash-only comparison is insufficient.
invocationPolicy.certification: Every fixture needs independently decoded structure/declarations and source-or-normative reference behavior matching the recipe, plus every inputRequirements item. Each role must resolve uniquely to original scope/key; missing opcode/template/call/selector is preparation failure, not permission to substitute a simpler graph.
invocationPolicy.gates: engine cases and engine-and-application cases count toward EngineCoreRC; application cases join ProductRC. engine-and-application needs both seam evidences for every invocation but counts once. ProductRC includes every required case and every invocation.
invocationPolicy.assertions: Most expected values compare exactly. mustNotInclude asserts absence from the complete original-key result; observationsOnly is a whitelist for every actual file observation (not a required sampling order/count); stringPattern expands the full exact u16 vector. Boolean integrity assertions must be computed from actual independent artifacts/state, never copied from input or expected.
